description: News search. Send a query; returns up to 10 Google News articles with title, URL, publisher, date and snippet, optionally limited to the last hour, day, week, month or year and to a country and language. Use to find recent coverage of a topic, company or event. Not for full article text (use /v1/fetch-page). Typical response about 1 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, lower case, such as us or gb.

language.description: Optional language code, lower case, such as en or pt-br.

query.description: Topic, company or event to find news about.

time_window.description: Only articles from the last hour, day, week, month or year.

name: quantagentshop_news_search
title: News search
